name: Improved Cunning
body:
You have an exceptional knack for learning.

Prerequisite: Cunning

Benefit: Gain a skill rank for each Hit Die you possess. You also gain a skill rank whenever you gain a Hit Die.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Its effects stack. A rogue may select this feat as a rogue talent.
